# A divider

Its subtitle, the paragraph right after it.

## A list with a footnote

- `##` starts a slide, `#` a section divider
- **Bold**, *italic* and `inline code`
- A third item, to give the body some height

† A paragraph that starts with a dagger becomes a slide footnote.

## Columns: a list beside a table

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
- `.columns` splits a slide
- Each `.column` sets its width
:::
::: {.column width="55%"}
| System  | Role |  Cores/node |
|:--------|:----:|------------:|
| Derecho | HPC  |         128 |
| Casper  | DAV  |          36 |
:::
::::

## ⚠︎ A warning slide {.caution .vcenter scale="1.15"}

- `{.caution}` sets the body on a soft field with a bar.
- Keep it for the slides that warn.

## A full-bleed photo slide {.feature background-image="images/example.jpg"}

### Photo slides

A `###` block puts the text on the field.

# Backup {.unnumbered}

A divider outside the count: no number, in every format.

## A backup slide

- An appendix's slides follow an unnumbered divider.

## Thank you! {.closing}

The closing slide.
